title: The geometric-electronic coupled design of diatomic catalyst towards oxygen reduction reaction
authors: Yan Liu, Yan Yang, Xuanni Lin, Yutao Lin, Zhiwen Zhuo, Dong Liu, Junjie Mao, Jun Jiang
coreIdea: Constructs a catalytic hot spot map using geometric and electronic descriptors to guide diatomic catalyst design.

adaptationBoundary: EcoMOF-AI borrows the coupled-descriptor visualization philosophy, not the ORR model, DFT dataset, ML workflow, or experimental claim.
